newsitem.title: GERMANY: Toepfer cuts EU 1997 grain forecast to 197-200 M T.
newsitem.headline: Toepfer cuts EU 1997 grain forecast to 197-200 M T.

text.p: German grain trader Alfred C Toepfer's monthly market report for June put the likely 1997 European Union grain crop at 197-200 million tonnes, thereby reducing an April forecast of 205 million tonnes.
The report cited dry conditions in Mediterranean countries which it said should override the effect of area expansion by two percent.
The 1996 grain crop in the EU totalled 200 million tonnes, according to Toepfer.
The newsletter gave the following break-down -- soft wheat 89 million tonnes (91 million 1996), durum 6.2 million (7.6), barley 51 million (51.6), maize 32-34 million (32.2).
It did not offer specific forecasts for rye, triticale, oats, sorghum or mixed grains.
Toepfer in May put the EU 1997 grain area at 37.3 million hectares (36.4 million ha in 1996).
